support_registry.text: {"blocking_evidence":null,"headline":"simple negation leaves a broad present-future state","reader_payoff":"The reader hears the desired exemption as an ongoing condition of non-testing rather than a past reversal or sharpened future oath.","reason":"The particle negates an indicative imperfect with simple verbal negation, not a stronger tense-mood negator.","representative_source_ids":["QG-35c7cd29","QS-6aa690c4","QS-c9c8e9f0"],"status":"used"}

1. **Faith as assayed material.** ف ت ن B001 is “assaying by trial.” The sequence saying “we believe” → not being left → being assayed assigns the assay the role of exposing what the utterance contains. The directional claim—that pressure reveals rather than creates the quality—is inferred; the ayah therefore reads as a demand that spoken faith become publicly testable material.
